'''Josep Graells Esquius'''{{family name footnote|lang=Catalan|Graells|Esquius}} (born 1 February 1964) is an [[Andorra]]n [[Olympic Games|Olympic]] [[Middle-distance running|middle-distance runner]]. He represented his country in the [[Athletics at the 1988 Summer Olympics – Men's 1500 metres|men's 1500 meters]] and the [[Athletics at the 1988 Summer Olympics – Men's 800 metres|men's 800 meters]] at the [[1988 Summer Olympics]]. His time was a 1:53.34 in the 800, and a 3:52.68 in the 1500 heats.<ref>{{cite Sports-Reference |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/gr/josep-graells-1.html |title=Josep Graells |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161203064408/http://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/gr/josep-graells-1.html |archive-date=2016-12-03 |quote=Full name: Josep Graells Esquius}}</ref>

Graells was the [[List of flag bearers for Andorra at the Olympics|flag bearer for Andorra]] in the [[1988 Summer Olympics Parade of Nations|Seoul 1988 opening ceremony]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.olympedia.org/flagbearers?country_id=AND |title=Flagbearers for Andorra |website=[[Olympedia]] |publisher=[[OlyMADMen]] |access-date=20 December 2023}}</ref>
